hits.evidence: Construction of AlumniFi Field, a privately funded 15,000-seat soccer stadium in southwest Detroit (Corktown/Mexicantown), began July 2026 for 2028, replacing the 7,933-seat 1936 Keyworth Stadium; nearly 6,000 seat deposits already taken. Not yet credited in Culture.
Sandia Resort & Casino is the front-of-shirt sponsor on the 2026 away kit (since 2024); the resort runs the 10,000 sq ft Sandia Sportsbook. Not counted in Values ('no betting sponsor found').

City-approved (2024) 10,000-seat soccer stadium at Balloon Fiesta Park in Albuquerque, replacing the baseball Isotopes Park; neighbourhood lawsuits dismissed and upheld on appeal (July 2026), 2028 opening targeted. Noted under Ownership but not credited in Culture.

Privately funded 20,000+ seat Republic Stadium in the downtown Railyards is under construction for 2028, replacing the 11,569-seat Heart Health Park at Cal Expo. Noted under Ownership but not credited in Culture.

Announced (March 2026) a privately financed 15,000-seat soccer stadium near St. Johns Town Center, Jacksonville, for 2028, replacing UNF's college Hodges Stadium; site plan released June 2026, permitting under way. Not yet credited in Culture.
